text: dsh-balance-whale 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 DeepSeek 余额侧栏小组件。它在侧边栏底部注册一个芯片，通过宿主提供的同源余额路由读取已登录账号的钱包数据，并在浏览器中显示余额、当前高峰或空闲价格时段，以及到下一次切换的倒计时。悬停可查看充值与赠送余额的分项、更新时间和价格说明；组件按周期自动刷新，也会在页面重新可见、窗口获得焦点或点击时更新。价格时段按北京时间工作日规则计算，周末及内置节假日全天为空闲时段。使用需要已登录的 DeepSeek 账号；插件未声明额外 API 密钥或设置项。

dsh-balance-whale adds a balance chip to the DSH sidebar. It reads the signed-in account and shows wallet totals, the current price period, and a countdown to the next change. Hover for recharge and bonus totals. A DeepSeek account is required; no extra API key is declared.
想在 DSH 侧边栏随时看 DeepSeek 账户余额和当前价格时段。
DSH 能不能显示模型价格什么时候从高峰切换到空闲？
Show my account balance and the next pricing-period change inside the DSH sidebar.
dsh-balance-whale 的功能「余额与时段芯片」：在侧栏底部显示账户余额、当前价格时段和切换倒计时，并可悬停查看余额分项。组件自动轮询，也响应页面显示、窗口聚焦和点击刷新。
使用前需登录 DeepSeek 账号；宿主通过账号服务读取钱包余额，浏览器只请求同源余额路由。
dsh-balance-whale README · dsh-balance-whale：

dsh-balance-whale README · dsh-balance-whale：A whale in the DSH sidebar footer that shows your DeepSeek account balance, a live countdown to the
next price switch, and whether you are on peak or off-peak pricing.

dsh-balance-whale README · dsh-balance-whale：- **Peak** — the whale is drawn bright and tilted, and the countdown runs in the peak colour.
- **Off-peak** — the whale is drawn pale and curled, and the countdown runs in the off-peak colour.
- A live `HH:MM:SS` between the whale and the balance counts down to the next switch, and the whale
  changes pose the moment it reaches zero.
- The balance refreshes **by itself** every 30 seconds, and immediately when the window regains
  focus or the page becomes visible. Nothing to click.

dsh-balance-whale README · dsh-balance-whale：The screenshots above are stills. In the running app the whale moves: it bobs and turns while the
price is at peak, and breathes slowly while it sleeps off-peak.

Hover the chip for the full picture: the price multiplier, the clock time of the next switch, the
recharge/bonus split, and how long ago the number was read.

dsh-balance-whale README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tespio/dsh-balance-whale
```

Prebuilt tarball, pinned to a release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/tespio/dsh-balance-whale/releases/download/v1.1.2/dsh-balance-whale-1.1.2.tgz
```

There is no build step and there are no dependencies — the package is plain JavaScript, so
installing it never asks you to approve build scripts. After a page refresh the chip appears beside
Settings in the sidebar footer.

dsh-balance-whale README · Install：Requires a DSH build where you are signed in to a DeepSeek account (Settings → Account). Without a
signed-in account the chip shows `—` and says so in its tooltip.

dsh-balance-whale README · How it works：- **Host half** (`index.js`) reads the signed-in account's Platform wallets through the harness
  account service and serves them as JSON on one loopback route, `/plugin/deepseek-balance`, cached
  for 10 seconds. The browser never receives a credential.
- **Client half** (`client.js`) registers a chip in the `sidebar.footer.action` slot, polls that
  route, and draws the whale inline as SVG. Styles use the host's `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so
  it follows light and dark themes.

dsh-balance-whale README · How it works：A failed read never blanks the number: the last good balance stays on screen while the next attempt
runs, retrying at 4s, 8s and 16s before settling back to the 30-second cadence.

dsh-balance-whale README · Pricing rule：Peak is **Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time** (UTC+8), with half-open ranges
(12:00 sharp is already off-peak). Everything else is off-peak at half price, and weekends plus
Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day. The rule and the whale artwork come from
[DeepSeek Status](https://github.com/tespio/DeepSeekStatus).

The switch is computed in the browser and re-armed exactly on the boundary, so the whale changes
pose on the minute rather than up to a poll late.

dsh-balance-whale README · Privacy：- No telemetry, no analytics. The only network request is the balance read the host performs through
  your existing Platform sign-in.
- The route returns wallet totals and timestamps only, is served from the same origin, and sends no
  CORS header, so other sites cannot read it.

dsh-balance-whale README · Related：[dsh-whale-widget](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget) covers this ground and
much more: a floating corner widget with usage accounting, per-turn cost, alerts, sounds and balance
templates for 30+ providers. If you want any of that, use it.

This plugin is deliberately the small one: a chip in the sidebar footer that shows the balance and
the current price period, with no panel, no settings, no extra files and no network beyond the
balance read.

dsh-balance-whale README · Notes：- The whale is the DeepSeek mark, taken from the [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) collection
  (CC0). "DeepSeek" and its logo belong to their owner; this is an unofficial widget.
- The Chinese public-holiday calendar is embedded (2025–2026). A new year needs a new release.
